## Stay Away!!!!

My doorbell and driveway camera stopped working shortly after Bell sold the company to API.  
It was a nightmare to get in touch with API. After a couple of months a tech finally showed up, he couldn't fix the problem and stated that I need a newer version device.  
API hasn't fixed the issue yet..  
Stay away from this company!!!

## Poor service n high charge n rude people [...] ## The Worst Service

If I could give a negative score, even that would not do justice. It is the worst service I continue to receive. I am appalled. Since Bell dumped its long-time customers on API, it has been absolute hell. I am not even sure if anyone is monitoring the station or if any action will be taken in case of issues.

## Unbelievably poor customer service and… [...] For me, the biggest problems have been:  
\ Faulty or unreliable equipment  
\ Limited technical support  
\ High charges for physical technician visits  
\ Poor customer service  
\ Difficulty getting my concerns properly heard  
\ Paying for services/equipment that I was unable to use properly  
I am sharing this review based on my personal experience as an API customer. I hope the company takes this feedback seriously and improves both its equipment reliability and customer service.

Delivery delays are a frequent challenge in ecommerce supply chains. They occur when suppliers fail to dispatch goods on time, creating bottlenecks that disrupt fulfillment and damage customer experience.

#### Causes [...] Customer experience – Missed delivery dates erode trust and drive negative reviews. Poor communication about delays further damages the reputation. Proactive updates, aligned expectations, and robust supplier collaboration help maintain satisfaction even when disruptions occur. Apis India faces criticism for its negligible brand equity, which makes it a price-taker unable to command premium pricing or defend market share from larger brands. The company's lack of brand strength and visibility traps it in a cycle of low market share and weak brand recall. Additionally, traceability issues have been highlighted, with concerns about adulteration and quality control in its products. The FDA has flagged manufacturing violations by Indian API makers, including Apis India, underscoring ongoing quality concerns.
